pi-zero-2-w.name: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W
pi-zero-2-w.description: Raspberry Pi OS Lite. Connect the USB host to the micro-USB data port labelled USB; PWR IN is for power only.

pi-4-b.name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B
pi-4-b.description: Raspberry Pi OS Lite. Connect the USB host to USB-C and provide separate power, for example PoE. USB-A ports cannot present storage. This profile has not been hardware-tested.
